_draft_history: v1 of this draft left the OUTPUT's audience and the input mechanism implicit. Models that ran the floor check correctly found gaps and asked, which SKILL.md:198 requires ('after any question, wait') — and a waiting model emits no gate question, so the grader scored correct elicitation as a failure to gate. Run 30485799617: claude-opus-5 asked for Audience and Input and was marked fail on P1 and n/a-precondition across all of P6. The draft now states audience, scope, format, path and input, so compress-and-gate is the only correct behaviour and gap-asking is genuinely over-elicitation.
